label: 模型与任务
def: 按模态和任务组织的模型与算法及其开源实现：大语言与多模态模型、视觉、语音、图像与视频生成、经典 NLP、强化学习

subs.label: 大语言与多模态模型
subs.def: 开源权重的基座 / 推理 / 代码 / 多模态大语言模型，含 GPT-2、Llama 这类早期模型
subs.def_en: Open-weight base, reasoning, coding, and multimodal language models, including early ones such as GPT-2 and Llama

subs.label: 预训练模型与经典 NLP
subs.def: BERT 一类的预训练模型、序列建模工具包、传统 NLP 库，以及时序、金融等其他基础模型
subs.def_en: BERT-style pretrained models, sequence-modeling toolkits, traditional NLP libraries, and other foundation models such as time series and finance

subs.label: 计算机视觉
subs.def: 目标检测、分割、人脸与姿态、视觉基础模型与 3D 视觉；OCR 引擎归入「文档解析与 OCR」
subs.def_en: Object detection, segmentation, face and pose, vision foundation models, and 3D vision; OCR engines go under Document Parsing & OCR

subs.label: 语音识别
subs.def: 语音转文字模型、推理加速与听写工具（Whisper 系、DeepSpeech 一类）
subs.def_en: Speech-to-text models, inference accelerators, and dictation tools (Whisper family, DeepSpeech)

subs.label: 语音合成、声音转换与音频处理
subs.def: 文字转语音、声音克隆与变声、音频分离，以及音频 / 音乐生成
subs.def_en: Text-to-speech, voice cloning and conversion, audio source separation, and audio and music generation

subs.label: 图像与视频生成
subs.def: 扩散模型与生成对抗网络、文生图 / 文生视频模型，以及承载它们的 WebUI 与节点工作流
subs.def_en: Diffusion models and GANs, text-to-image and text-to-video models, and the WebUIs and node workflows that run them

subs.label: 图像增强与换脸
subs.def: 超分辨率、人脸修复、去背景、擦除补全、换脸与深度伪造等面向已有图像 / 视频的处理
subs.def_en: Processing of existing images and video: super-resolution, face restoration, background removal, inpainting, face swapping, and deepfakes

subs.label: 强化学习与具身智能
subs.def: 强化学习环境与算法、机器人学习和具身智能仿真
subs.def_en: Reinforcement learning environments and algorithms, robot learning, and embodied-AI simulation

subs.label: 推荐系统
subs.def: 推荐与排序系统的模型和线上服务代码，包括社交平台开源的信息流推荐算法
subs.def_en: Models and serving code for recommendation and ranking systems, including feed-recommendation algorithms open-sourced by social platforms

def_en: Models and algorithms organized by modality and task, with their open-source implementations: language and multimodal models, vision, speech, image and video generation, classic NLP, reinforcement learning

label: 训练、推理与工具链
def: 模型开发与运行所需的框架、训练、部署、接入、评测和配套工具，LLM 与传统 ML 通用

subs.label: 框架与数值基础库
subs.def: 深度学习 / 机器学习框架、自动微分、分布式计算与端侧推理框架，以及 NumPy、pandas 这类基础数据库（PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX、scikit-learn、XGBoost 一类）
subs.def_en: Deep learning and machine learning frameworks, autodiff, distributed computing, on-device inference frameworks, and base libraries such as NumPy and pandas (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit-learn, XGBoost)

subs.label: 训练与微调
subs.def: 预训练、微调、强化学习后训练与模型改造
subs.def_en: Pre-training, fine-tuning, RL post-training, and model modification

subs.label: 推理服务与加速
subs.def: 高吞吐推理服务引擎与底层注意力加速
subs.def_en: High-throughput inference serving engines and low-level attention acceleration

subs.label: 本地推理
subs.def: 在个人电脑 / 端侧设备上跑模型的引擎与工具
subs.def_en: Engines and tools for running models on personal computers and edge devices

subs.label: API 网关与中转
subs.def: 统一多家模型 API、路由转发、订阅中转
subs.def_en: Unify multiple model APIs, route requests, and relay subscriptions

subs.label: 观测、评测与 Prompt 管理
subs.def: LLM 应用的链路追踪、评测、红队与 Prompt 优化
subs.def_en: Tracing, evaluation, red-teaming, and prompt optimization for LLM apps

subs.label: 标注、可视化与 Demo 工具
subs.def: 数据标注、模型可视化与可解释性、机器学习 Demo 界面等围绕模型开发的工具
subs.def_en: Tools around model development: data labeling, model visualization and interpretability, and machine-learning demo UIs

def_en: Frameworks, training, deployment, access, evaluation, and supporting tools for building and running models, shared by LLMs and classic ML

label: 数据与检索

subs.def_en: Retrieval-augmented generation engines, document Q&A, and enterprise knowledge bases

subs.label: 向量数据库
subs.def: 向量存储与相似度检索
subs.def_en: Vector storage and similarity search

subs.label: 文档解析与 OCR

subs.label: 数据分析 / Text-to-SQL
